document_api_meta.title: Get TradeIn Account Transactions
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Retrieves account transaction records for the currently authorized TradeIn supplier.
The supplier identity and associated seller identity are resolved from the authorization context. The caller cannot specify seller_id.
Only account transactions generated by the TradeIn business are returned.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: start_time
request_query_param.desc: Filter account transactions created on or after this time. Use RFC 3339 format with timezone.

request_query_param.name: end_time
request_query_param.desc: Filter account transactions created before this time. Use RFC 3339 format with timezone.

request_query_param.name: flow_type
request_query_param.desc: Filters account transactions by business transaction type. Allowed values: RECHARGE, WITHDRAW, REVERSE. If omitted, all supported transaction types are returned.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: The number of account transactions to return per page.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token returned by the previous request. Omit it when requesting the first page.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^flows
response_param.desc: The TradeIn account transactions that match the query conditions. An empty array is returned when no transaction matches.

response_param.name: ^^amount
response_param.desc: The transaction amount and currency. Use direction to determine whether the transaction is a credit or debit.

response_param.name: ^^^amount
response_param.desc: The transaction amount represented as a decimal string.

response_param.name: ^^^currency
response_param.desc: The currency code in ISO 4217 format.

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the account transaction was created, in RFC 3339 format.

response_param.name: ^^direction
response_param.desc:
The direction of the account transaction.
- IN: Funds credited to the supplier's account.
- OUT: Funds debited from the supplier's account.

response_param.name: ^^origin_transaction_id
response_param.desc: The original account transaction ID associated with a reversed transaction. This field is returned only for a REVERSE transaction when available.

response_param.name: ^^reference_id
response_param.desc: The TradeIn business order ID associated with the account transaction.

response_param.name: ^^transaction_id
response_param.desc: The unique ID of the account transaction.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The TradeIn business transaction type.
- RECHARGE: Funds credited through a recharge.
- WITHDRAW: Funds debited through a payout.
- REVERSE: Funds returned after a payout reversal.

response_param.name: ^has_more
response_param.desc: Whether more account transactions are available.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page. The value is empty when no more account transactions are available.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: The total number of account transactions that match the query conditions.
